headline: Gateway Distriparks receives ESG rating from CRISIL
summary: Gateway Distriparks Limited has announced that it received an ESG rating from CRISIL ESG Ratings & Analytics Limited. The company informed the stock exchanges regarding this sustainability assessment. Routine ESG ratings are standard corporate disclosures and do not directly impact near-term financial earnings. Retail investors should note this as part of corporate governance tracking.
why_it_matters: Routine ESG score update, no immediate financial impact.
